newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine supermarket sales up in March, April.
newsitem.headline: Argentine supermarket sales up in March, April.

text.p: Argentine supermarket sales rose to $894 million in March, a 6.6 increase over March 1996, according to an Economy Ministry report issued Monday.
It said preliminary data put supermaket sales in April at $799 million, 2.8 percent more than in April last year.
"With these April sales estimates, sales in the first four months of the year would be five percent higher than those in the same period 1996," the ministry said in its monthly report.
A survey of supermakets shows they expect May sales to grow five percent from May 1996, the report said.
